test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_table_short_{array_type} (`set` Array({array_type}), `subset` Array({array_type})) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE test_table_low_cardinality (`set` Array(LowCardinality(String))) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_table_small_{array_type} SELECT groupArraySample(5000)(rand64()) AS set, groupArraySample(500)(rand64()) AS subset FROM numbers(10000000) GROUP BY number % 5000;
INSERT INTO test_table_medium_{array_type} SELECT groupArraySample(50000)(rand64()) AS set, groupArraySample(5000)(rand64()) AS subset FROM numbers(25000000) GROUP BY number % 50000;
INSERT INTO test_table_large_{array_type} SELECT groupArraySample(500000)(rand64()) AS set, groupArraySample(500000)(rand64()) AS subset FROM numbers(50000000) GROUP BY number % 500000;

INSERT INTO test_table_short_{array_type} SELECT arr, [arr[1], arr[2], arr[3]] FROM (SELECT arrayMap(i -> toInt64(number + i) % 100, range(multiIf('{array_type}' = 'Int8', 127, '{array_type}' = 'Int16', 63, '{array_type}' = 'Int32', 31, 15))) AS arr FROM numbers(1000000)) SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192

INSERT INTO test_table_low_cardinality SELECT arrayConcat(arrayMap(j -> toString(cityHash64(number, j) % 5000), range(8)), if(number % 2 = 0, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7'], [])) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM test_table_small_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM test_table_medium_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM test_table_large_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM test_table_short_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7']) FROM test_table_low_cardinality FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAny(set, ['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7']) FROM test_table_low_cardinality FORMAT Null
